topic: Colors and marking on naval aircraft.
syllabus_extract: Colors and marking on naval aircraft.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Activity: Identification of paint codes and marking symbols. Safety: Use of PPE and ventilation. Supervision: Instructor direct observation.
intro_questions: Why is corrosion prevention critical for naval aircraft?
What is the primary function of aircraft paint?
Name two common types of aircraft corrosion.

development.content:
Surface protection materials overview
Paint identification codes and standards
Primer and topcoat functions

Restoration of various paint types
Paint application techniques
Dope shop equipment and articles

Common paint and dope troubles
Troubleshooting paint defects
Marking standards and color codes

summary_questions: Explain the difference between primer and topcoat functions.
Identify a common paint defect and its probable cause.
Why are specific color codes used for naval aircraft markings?
home_assignment_question: Research the preservation phases of naval aircraft and list the materials used for each phase.

pft_rows.syllabus: A/c preservation phases and types of preservation Materials used for preservation, recording procedures when a/c placed in preservation.
